notes: One row per provider in the priority subset processed this run (joined to an enforcement action, or 5+ services, or several states). match_kind: accepted_unique, accepted_unique_in_state, ambiguous, no_match, excluded_individual_or_unknown (never queried; no name kept), excluded_individual_abr (ABR says individual; no ABN or name kept), accepted_unconfirmed, lookup_error. score is the MatchingNames score of the accepted candidate; candidates is the number of distinct current non-individual ABNs returned (maxResults 10). looked_up_at and response_sha256 are for the name search; details_* for the AbnDetails confirmation. ABR business names that read as a person's name are withheld unless already an ACECQA organisation name. Parent and subsidiary relationships are NOT derivable from free ABR data: they need paid ASIC extracts and are out of scope. A group here is one legal entity (one ABN or ACN) holding several provider approvals, nothing more.

abr_source.licence: ABN Lookup Web Services Agreement v9.9.7, https://abr.business.gov.au/Tools/WebServicesAgreement (see research/2026-10-30-register-abn-lookup.md)
abr_source.cache: data/raw/abr-lookup/ is a local, gitignored cache; each row records the query endpoint, looked_up_at and the sha256 of the cached response instead
abr_source.credential: the GUID is never stored; every recorded URL has the guid parameter removed

run.subset_rule: joined to an enforcement action, or service_count >= 5, or state_count > 1
